title: Among German drivers who were eliminated in the first qualifying period (Q1
question: Among German drivers who were eliminated in the first qualifying period (Q1) of race 895, find the oldest one who also completed lap 2 in that same race and has a non-null driver code.

prediction.sql: SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039 FROM qualifying AS q JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058 WHERE q.XCL_057 = 895 AND q.XCL_063 IS NULL AND d.XCL_041 = 'German' AND NOT d.XCL_035 IS NULL AND d.XCL_034 IN (SELECT lt.XCL_044 FROM lapTimes AS lt WHERE lt.XCL_043 = 895 AND lt.XCL_045 = 2) ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC LIMIT 1

eligibility.scope: qualifying row for the target race

eligibility.predicate: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lapTimes WHERE lapTimes.XCL_043 = 895 AND lapTimes.XCL_044 = drivers.XCL_034 AND lapTimes.XCL_045 = 2)

arguments.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
WHERE q.XCL_057 = 895
  AND q.XCL_063 IS NULL
  AND d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND d.XCL_035 IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lapTimes AS lt
      WHERE lt.XCL_043 = 895
        AND lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
        AND lt.XCL_045 = 2
  )
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1

JOIN qualifying q ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.XCL_034 = lt.XCL_044 AND q.XCL_057 = lt.XCL_043
WHERE d.XCL_041 = 'Germany'
  AND q.XCL_057 = 895
  AND q.XCL_060 = 1
  AND lt.XCL_045 = 2
  AND d.XCL_037 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
WHERE q.XCL_057 = 895
  AND q.XCL_063 IS NULL
  AND d.XCL_041 = 'German'
  AND d.XCL_035 IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM lapTimes AS lt
      WHERE lt.XCL_043 = 895
        AND lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
        AND lt.XCL_045 = 2
  )
ORDER BY d.XCL_040 ASC
LIMIT 1
